reason: The contract does not support the applied adjustments: volume discounts were applied to Intensive Gastrointestinal Isolation Room Occupancy, Comprehensive Infectious Nursing Observation, and Intermittent Pulmonary Rehabilitation Programme despite quantities far below the discount thresholds; a premium was incorrectly applied to Ambulatory Ophthalmic Case Conference (quantity 3 < threshold 6); the Standard Endocrine Endoscopic Procedure was under‑billed (2 procedures should total 248,900 c, not 124,450 c); and the Advanced Metabolic Anaesthesia Administration should be excluded (within 7 days of the trigger procedure) but was billed at full price.
